title: Our story
subtitle: Every project begins with an idea, and ours began with a different vision.

chapters.title: A different beginning
paragraphs: The story of our website started with a proposal from co-Founder Shan Asha Trinidad: a digital repository where the capstone projects of City of Malabon University could be collected and made freely accessible to students.

Although the idea was intended to make academic works easier to access, feedback from our professors raised concerns regarding copyright and the amount of time and resources that would be required to upload and maintain every capstone project.

chapters.title: From archive to adventure
paragraphs: From this first concept came our Founder and lead developer, Dave Joseph Cabilangan. Drawing from his experience as a web developer at the startup company EiravTek, he saw an opportunity to transform the idea of a repository into something more interactive.
He introduced gamification as a way to turn a conventional collection of academic resources into an environment where students could explore, interact, and discover.

chapters.title: Shaped together
paragraphs: As the project continued to take shape, assistant researchers Mark Rowin Chester V. Ong and Rhylam Castillo contributed their own ideas, perspectives, and recommendations. Through collaboration, research, and inspiration from existing digital systems, the original repository concept gradually evolved into something more ambitious.

This development also reflected a broader concern we observed among students and library personnel. Traditional library use often depends on physical access, manual browsing, operating schedules, limited copies of resources, and often-forgotten filing and information retrieval. These conditions can make the experience less interactive for students who are increasingly familiar with digital platforms and interactive applications.

chapters.title: A space to discover
paragraphs: From these ideas and observations, the City of Malabon University Gamified Virtual Library was born.

Our vision is to bring library exploration into an interactive 3D environment where students can navigate, discover resources, and interact with library-related features in a different way. The platform combines library information with selected gamification elements to create a virtual space centered on exploration and discovery.

closing: A place where learning, exploration, and technology share the same space.
